## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Boerne, United States. It starts at 401 Obst Road.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Join an authentic Texas rodeo experience! Upon entering the grounds, guests are welcomed with delicious Texas BBQ and cold drinks, all while enjoying good ol' country music. Explore Western-themed vendors selling cowboy hats, leather goods, jewelry, and more.
>
> For some excitement, try the mechanical bull challenge. Then, head to the covered arena for a rodeo featuring longhorn cattle, a drill team, bull riding, team roping, and barrel racing. Kids can join in mutton busting and a calf scramble. Finish the day by dancing to a live country band in the pavilion.
